Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. report.answer: Fixed: `consumptionOrder` in src/domain/batches.js sorted newest-received first; it now follows the FEFO rule in docs/DATA.md (earliest expiry first, no-expiry batches last, then received date, then id), so bechamel takes lot HD-1022 first. Two regression tests were added; they fail without the fix, and `npm test` (28 pass) and `npm run lint` pass with it. Changes are uncommitted, and any batches already consumed in the wrong order keep their existing ledger movements.

check.why: FEFO by the data rules, with a regression test
